translationRepairs: Gao Huan memorialized to trim state enfeoffments and reward civil and military officials; Zuan received the usual grant and was enfeoffed marquis of Shouzhang.
Gao Huan memorialized to trim state enfeoffments and reward civil and military officials; Zuan received the usual grant and was enfeoffed baron of Shouzhang.
s0009 has 封壽張伯; 伯 is the baron/earl rank, not marquis (侯), so “baron of Shouzhang” correctly matches the Chinese title.
He was sent out as inspector of West Yan Province, where he investigated and enforced prohibitions. After more than a year he was dismissed when the charges could not be proved.
He was sent out as inspector of West Yan Province, where he investigated and enforced prohibitions. After more than a year he was cleared when the charges could not be proved.
s0100’s 以無驗獲免 means he obtained clearance when nothing was proven; “dismissed” wrongly suggests removal from office, while “cleared” matches the Chinese.
In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of the imperial clan.
In the first year of Heqing he was summoned and appointed minister of sacrificial worships.
s0144 has 祠部尚書, the board of sacrificial worships/rites, not the imperial-clan office (宗正); “minister of sacrificial worships” restores the correct office.
In Xinghe Zhong, Gao Cheng summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.
During Xinghe, Gao Cheng summoned him as vault attendant and made him court gentleman attendant.
s0185’s 興和中 is the conventional “during Xinghe”; treating 中 as part of a name “Xinghe Zhong” invents a place/person the Chinese does not support.
When Shizong died, he barred the gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
Tree-death and barred gate — to the end, bright in faith and obedience.
s0218 is only 樹死拒關，終明信順 and never names Shizong; the proposal rightly removes that invention, but “By the tree-death” is awkward, so the revision keeps the terse allusive pair.
